news.title: The AI world is getting ‘loopy’
news.description: The loop takes agentic AI a step further by authorizing a swarm of agents to work continuously in the background, endlessly.

news.title: AI chipmaker Groq confirms $650M raise, re-staffs after Nvidia’s $20B not-acqui-hire deal
news.description: What does an AI company do after one of those not-acqui-hire deals? Groq raised money, is leaning into its neocloud business, and is hiring new execs.

news.title: Nvidia wants to cut data center water use, but that’s not the same as fixing AI’s water problem
news.description: Nvidia announced a new cooling system that cuts water use inside the data center. But it does nothing to address AI's biggest water use — fossil fuel power plants.

news.title: Google DeepMind bets $75M on AI’s future in Hollywood with A24 deal
news.description: Google DeepMind and A24 are teaming up to build AI filmmaking tools.

news.title: Why an AI company cleaned my New York City apartment for free
news.description: An AI company is sending free cleaners door-to-door in a bid to train the robots it hopes one day will replace them.

news.title: New video game console aims to get kids moving
news.description: The Nex Playground will cost £269 (€319) when it is released on 22 June in the UK and Ireland.

news.title: OpenAI Launches Full-Scale Effort to Patch Open-Source Bugs as It Takes on Anthropic’s Mythos
news.description: Amid concerns about AI models’ cybersecurity capabilities, OpenAI revealed an improved version of GPT-5.5-Cyber and its “Patch the Planet” initiative to fix open-source software bugs.

news.title: 氪星晚报｜赢创计划全球裁员3200人；台积电28nm较年初减产25%；三星电子向韩国所有员工开放ChatGPT和Codex
news.description:
大公司：
  赢创计划全球裁员3200人
  赢创近日宣布，将延长“赢创定制”增效计划，涉及赢创全球所有业务及职能部门，拟裁减约3200个岗位，其中德国本土约占2150个。相关措施计划于2027年启动，持续至2029年底。6月22日，赢创确认，德国以外地区将削减1050个职位，中国区包含在内，但具体裁员数量尚未明确。“赢创定制”计划于2023年10月推出，原定目标为2026年底前累计
